script: const page=pixso.getNodeById('3:3');const frames={};for(const id of ['3:2208','3:10790','20:11343','3:2542','5:13998']){const n=pixso.getNodeById(id);const panel=n.findOne(t=>t.name==='Ritual · compact progress')??n;frames[id]={name:n.name,parts:panel.children.map(t=>({id:t.id,name:t.name,type:t.type,children:t.children?.map(c=>({id:c.id,name:c.name,type:c.type}))})),texts:panel.findAll(t=>t.type==='TEXT').map(t=>[t.id,t.name,t.characters]),rx:(()=>{try{return n.reactions}catch(e){return String(e)}})()};}return{sections:page.children.map(n=>[n.id,n.name]),frames};
